title: Frozen + unseen/adversarial extraction comparison
objective: Produce a reproducible, read-only comparison of the frozen deterministic extraction baseline and the Batch 03 experimental LLM semantic-proposal path. Measure role and candidate extraction quality, provenance integrity, structural/enrichment coverage, rejection causality, latency, and cost. Record evidence only; Batch 05 alone selects an architecture.
mustNotChange: deterministic Extraction V1 semantics or frozen-baseline behavior
experimental LLM provider, prompt, proposal schema, deterministic assembler, shared verifier, or deterministic normalizer behavior
production extraction authority remains the existing deterministic baseline
no Batch 05 architecture decision or recommendation
evaluation, policy, verdict, canonical persistence, dossier, serving, UI, or Batch 01 source/provenance immutability behavior
no benchmark-specific extractor fix, prompt/config tuning, fixture rewrite, or selective rerun after results without an explicit scope amendment
requiredVerification: freeze the deterministic regression population as radar-certification/corpus/001.json through 100.json at batchStartCommit and do not modify it
declare unseen and adversarial fixture IDs, immutable content hashes, source identities, partition membership, and expected mechanical validity before either provider runs

measure role and candidate semantic quality separately, including provenance/span validity, labeled precision/recall or documented equivalent, structural coverage, metric/entity enrichment coverage, and rejection/failure causality
report role false positives separately for P&L ownership, reporting line, people/team authority, and decision authority

report deterministic baseline parity, LLM local-proposal rejection versus whole-run rejection/failure, unresolved mechanical failures, cache/config identity, model/prompt/proposal-schema/assembler versions, latency, token usage, cost, and unavailable telemetry
retain raw fixture manifests, provider outputs, verifier outcomes, scores, rejection sidecars, and telemetry under audit-reports/gate1b-batch04/
do not alter an extractor, prompt, fixture, label, or scoring rule in response to benchmark results without an explicit scope amendment and separately identified rerun
build/certification only when required by the touched contract boundary; prefer targeted tests during development
acknowledge every governed implementation/test/substantive transition-documentation commit in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json
npm run transition:check after acknowledgement and before agent completion
completionEvidence: fixed frozen, unseen, and adversarial partitions with immutable fixture identities and retained raw comparison artifacts

separate role and candidate comparison metrics covering semantic quality, provenance validity, structural/enrichment coverage, high-risk false positives, rejection causality, reproducibility, latency, and cost
documented deterministic baseline parity and experimental failure/rejection rates
an evidence-only comparison report with no extraction architecture selection, production authority change, canonical persistence, or downstream consumer change
extraction architecture decision remains OPEN and Batch 05 remains unauthorized
all governed commits made during the batch are acknowledged in the transition implementation ledger
agentCompletionRule: Every committed change touching a non-governance path must be acknowledged by exact commit SHA in docs/transition/IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.json before the agent may report completion. Uncommitted governed changes fail transition control. Tests are governed changes and require explicit authorization in allowedPathPrefixes. Update RADAR_TRANSITION_CONTROL.md itself only when gate/scope/decision/invariant/exit criteria change.
scopeChangeRule: If implementation requires a path, corpus change, score change, prompt/config/extractor change, or semantic owner outside this manifest, stop first. Amend the control record/state/batch scope explicitly; do not self-tune the benchmark. Batch 05 is not authorized by this manifest.
